description: Historical Reddit POSTS from one subreddit, back to ~2005 — via the Arctic Shift archive, not the live Reddit API (which the `reddit` pack uses and which only reaches ~1,000 recent results with no reliable date filter). PREFER for "Reddit posts about X in/before <year>", "what did r/<sub> post about Y historically", or any request the live reddit pack cannot date-filter. Filter by date range (after/before, ISO dates like "2019-01-01") and/or keyword (query, matched against title+body). Returns id, title, author, created_utc (ISO), score, num_comments, permalink. A subreddit Arctic Shift has never indexed is reported as a loud error, never a silent empty list.

after.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. "2019-01-01") — only posts created on/after this date.

before.description: Optional ISO date (e.g. "2020-01-01") — only posts created before this date.

query.description: Optional keyword — matched against post title and body text.

sort.description: "asc" or "desc" by post date (default "desc", newest first).

subreddit.description: Subreddit name without the r/ prefix, e.g. "datasets".

name: reddit_history_posts
title: Reddit History Posts
